description: Eval corpus for tune_relevance_threshold.py (Milestone 4). Each sample is a (query, results[]) pair with an expected verdict: 'relevant' (the gate must NOT abstain) or 'off_topic' (the gate should abstain — best result score should fall below relevance_min_cosine). Modeled on tune_routing_threshold.py's sweep-and-pin-precision-first shape, but here the costly class is false-abstention on genuinely-relevant results (SEARCH_RELEVANCE_GATE_ENABLED must never make real answers worse), so the sweep should pin false-abstention-rate low FIRST, then maximize junk-catch recall — the inverse priority order from the routing sweep, where wallet false-positives were the costly class. Extended 2026-07-04 with 17 real Brave query/result pairs (14 relevant across sports/crypto/weather/knowledge/product domains, 3 off-topic junk-mismatch pairs) to move beyond the original n=8 synthetic-description first-pass calibration.
